summary.text: A 52-year-old immunosuppressed man presented with fever, impaired consciousness and headache. His history included curatively resected T1N0M0 gastric cancer complicated by post-operative pancytopenia, aplastic anaemia diagnosed on bone marrow biopsy, and bone marrow transplantation leading to graft versus host disease. At presentation he had pancytopenia and was being treated with prednisolone.

Chest CT showed a dense right upper lobe mass consolidation with ground-glass opacity. Blood cultures grew Staphylococcus, bronchiolar lavage grew Stenotrophomonas maltophilia and cerebrospinal fluid examination was unremarkable. Serial brain CT 2 days apart showed a rapidly growing low density left parietal mass; non-contrast MRI showed 50 mm left parietal and 33 mm left occipital lesions with haemorrhagic change and restricted diffusion. Differentials were infective encephalitis (primary), tumour, infarction (less likely), post-transplantation lymphoproliferative disease and tumefactive demyelination.

He developed multiorganism septicaemia with Cryptococcus, Nocardia and Staphylococcal species identified. A broad-spectrum regimen of doripenem, linezolid, clindamycin and azithromycin was commenced, but his condition deteriorated further and he required intubation. Decompressive neurosurgery for cerebral oedema was carried out.

The patient died. Granulomatous amoebic encephalitis due to Acanthamoeba spp. was diagnosed on autopsy, with amoebic lesions also found in the lungs. The article presents this as a fatal case of amoebic encephalitis due to Acanthamoeba spp. in an immunosuppressed man.

ambiguities.issue: The five lines after the MRI paragraph form the bullet list of the case report's own "Differential diagnoses" section, so all five are recorded as this patient's differentials (assertion possible). The tumour line says "primary or secondary from previous gastric cancer" without choosing either, and no line states that a differential was excluded.

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not assert primary or secondary tumour, and do not record any differential as ruled out or confirmed; infarction was only "considered less likely".

ambiguities.issue: The source says the patient required intubation but does not state that intubation was carried out.

evidence.quote: the patient’s condition deteriorated further and he required intubation

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not record intubation as completed.

ambiguities.issue: Prednisolone is described as ongoing at presentation ("was being treated"); no dose, route, indication or later status is stated, and the cause of the immunosuppression is not named in one statement.

evidence.quote: Subsequent bone marrow transplantation led to graft versus host disease and, at the time of presentation, the patient had pancytopenia and was being treated with prednisolone.

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not infer prednisolone as the cause of immunosuppression, or its use after presentation.

ambiguities.issue: Table 1 to Table 4 summarise 29 reviewed cases that include the current case; the tables are not separated by case, so none of their counts or percentages are individual patient values.

article_limitations: Tables 1 to 4 and the discussion summarise 29 literature cases including the current case and are not copied to the patient.

The five listed differential diagnoses sit under the case report's "Differential diagnoses" section heading and are recorded as differentials; the tumour subtype (primary or secondary) is not asserted.
No dates, times or intervals are given except the 2-day interval between the serial brain CT images, so few temporal relations are stated.
Intubation is stated as required, not as performed.
Visual status in the annotation figures is not_inspected by convention; the three images were inspected separately in visual.json.
